Reasoning: This stage keeps the cap physically grasped, holds the panda_fingertip position fixed within 0.01 m, and commands a positive 45 degree twist of the grasped estop_cap_center about its object +z axis. The object_grasped term represents maintaining the closed grasp/contact needed to transmit the twist. The freeze_position term represents keeping the fingertip origin fixed during the twist. The directional_rotate term represents the finite commanded twist limit of 45 degrees about estop_cap_center +z. The API does not provide explicit predicates for unlocked-state detection, 5 degree unlocked tolerance, gripper joint-value feedback, finger squeeze/contact effort feedback, slip detection, or continuous feedback monitoring, so those are noted but not separately encoded.
